真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 86 页

按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

原第1–4段连续裁切；词表A–J保留原题所有选项，含OCR漏掉的I已按原选项和答案页恢复。NG21已核对完整文章。

原文片段 · 1The crowded and bustling streets of Delhi teem with life. Stop to listen and, above the din of rickshaws and buses, you'll hear a multitude of languages, as more than 20 million people go about their daily lives. Many were born and raised here, and many millions more have recently made India's capital their home, having moved from surrounding neighbourhoods, cities and states or across the country, often in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life. Some arrive speaking fluent Hindi, the dominant language in Delhi (and the official language of government), but many arrive speaking any number of India's 22 officially recognised languages, let alone the hundreds of regional languages in a country of more than 1.3 billion people.

原文片段 · 2A team of researchers led by Professor Ianthi Tsimpli of Cambridge University is currently working on a project collecting data on 1,000 primary-age children in Delhi and the cities of Hyderabad and Bihar. The overriding aim of the four-year project, called 'Multilingualism and Multiliteracy', is to find out why in a country where multilingualism is so common (more than 255 million people in India speak at least two languages, and nearly 90 million speak three or more languages), the many benefits of speaking more than one language, observed in schools in Europe for instance, do not apply to many of India's schoolchildren.

原文片段 · 3'Each year across India, 600,000 children are tested, and year after year over 50% of children in Standard 5 [ten-year-olds] cannot read a Standard 2 [seven-year-olds] task fluently, and just under 50% of them cannot solve a Standard 2 subtraction task,' says Tsimpli. She explains that low educational achievement can lead to many of these students dropping out of school - a problem disproportionately affecting female students.

原文片段 · 4Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home. The research project, which focuses on 8 to 11-year old schoolchildren in rural and urban areas, collects data on whether the schoolchildren live in slum* or non-slum areas. Many of the children have moved from remote, rural areas to urban areas. They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

第 22 题作答
保留作答，查看答案

先作答；不确定的题也可记录判断与疑点。

材料精读 · 内容与词句

德里的语言多样性来自长期居住与人口迁移。研究关注一个表面矛盾：社会中多语现象普遍，一些学生却没有呈现其他教育环境里观察到的益处。文章把调查问题落到家庭语言、学校授课语言、贫困与学习环境之间的关系，而未先判定多语本身有害。

原文片段 · 1
The crowded and bustling streets of Delhi teem with life. Stop to listen and, above the din of rickshaws and buses, you'll hear a multitude of languages, as more than 20 million people go about their daily lives. Many were born and raised here, and many millions more have recently made India's capital their home, having moved from surrounding neighbourhoods, cities and states or across the country, often in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life. Some arrive speaking fluent Hindi, the dominant language in Delhi (and the official language of government), but many arrive speaking any number of India's 22 officially recognised languages, let alone the hundreds of regional languages in a country of more than 1.3 billion people.

繁忙街道的声音引出多语言共存，迁入者常怀着更好工作和生活的希望来到首都。有人熟练使用占主导地位的印地语，也有人主要使用其他官方或地区语言。let alone 强调官方语言数量之外还有更多地区语言；统计值与人口描述沿用原文时点。

原文片段 · 2
A team of researchers led by Professor Ianthi Tsimpli of Cambridge University is currently working on a project collecting data on 1,000 primary-age children in Delhi and the cities of Hyderabad and Bihar. The overriding aim of the four-year project, called 'Multilingualism and Multiliteracy', is to find out why in a country where multilingualism is so common (more than 255 million people in India speak at least two languages, and nearly 90 million speak three or more languages), the many benefits of speaking more than one language, observed in schools in Europe for instance, do not apply to many of India's schoolchildren.

研究团队对千名小学年龄儿童收集资料，目标不是证明会多种语言一定有益或有害，而是理解为何在某些欧洲学校观察到的益处没有出现在许多印度学生身上。observed in schools in Europe 限定比较经验的来源，不能把它扩大为所有欧洲儿童的普遍结论。

原文片段 · 3
'Each year across India, 600,000 children are tested, and year after year over 50% of children in Standard 5 [ten-year-olds] cannot read a Standard 2 [seven-year-olds] task fluently, and just under 50% of them cannot solve a Standard 2 subtraction task,' says Tsimpli. She explains that low educational achievement can lead to many of these students dropping out of school - a problem disproportionately affecting female students.

研究者引述重复出现的低学习表现：许多五年级儿童仍难以完成二年级阅读和减法任务。这里的比较体现学习进展不足，后果可能是辍学，且女生受到不成比例的影响。can lead to 是风险关系，不是说每个表现偏低的儿童都会离校。

原文片段 · 4
Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home. The research project, which focuses on 8 to 11-year old schoolchildren in rural and urban areas, collects data on whether the schoolchildren live in slum* or non-slum areas. Many of the children have moved from remote, rural areas to urban areas. They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

研究进一步检查学校授课语言与家庭语言不同是否可能影响学习，同时记录城乡、住区和迁移背景。家庭贫困限制居住选择，迁移又可能造成儿童原有语言与迁入地语言不同。whether 和 could be caused 表示研究中的问题，不能直接改成已经确定的唯一原因。

词语与搭配
in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life

怀着获得更好工作与生活的希望

in the hope of 后接动名词，表达迁移者的动机，不表示愿望必然实现。

The overriding aim

最主要的目标

overriding 强调优先地位；原文用来概括项目需要回答的核心问题。

low educational achievement

较低的学习成就

在文中由具体阅读与计算表现说明，不能直接等同于儿童智力较低。

differs from the language used at home

与家庭使用的语言不同

differ from 比较两个明确对象，这里是学校教学语言和家庭语言。

句子精读
Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home.

Tsimpli 和同事正在调查，这些较低的学习成果是否可能与印度学校的一种情况有关：儿童接受教学的语言常常不同于家里使用的语言。

whether 从句是 investigating 的内容，could be caused 保留待验证的可能性。where 描述学校体系中的情况；that children are taught in 修饰 language，句末的 in 与该语言搭配，表示以某种语言授课。

They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

这些儿童的家庭十分贫困，以至于他们不得不住在贫民区；而且，由于迁移，他们使用的语言可能不同于当地的地区语言。

They 回指从偏远农村迁往城市的许多儿童。so poor 后省略了 that，引出居住条件的结果。and 后另加迁移造成的语言差异，may 保留个体差别；贫困与语言差异不是完全相同的一个原因。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
differs from the language used at home

与家庭语言不同

适合解释某些儿童理解课堂内容时面临的额外要求，避免把语言差异等同于能力不足。
